messages:
acme-admin: Hey @josh, one of our engineers accepted the invite to project `acme-prod` but when they switch to that project the console shows "You don't have permission (403)" and the Billing tab is missing. They can hit the API fine with their API key. Started after we rotated our Okta OIDC client last night.
josh_support: Thanks — can you confirm how the invite was accepted (email link vs console)? and the affected user (email)? Also which org id/project id?
acme-admin: Invite accepted via email link. User: sarah@acme.com. Org: 112233. Project: acme-prod (proj_987). She can `curl` and list projects: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects` => 200 / projects include proj_987. But console GET for UI perms returns 403.
sre_kate: Can you paste the console/audit log entry for the invite accept? quick check: are they in any mapped groups?
acme-admin: Paste from audit: ```
{"ts": "2026-03-15T02:11:02Z", "event":"invite.accept", "user":"sarah@acme.com", "status":"accepted", "group_attrs": {}} 
``` shows `group_attrs` empty even though Okta group `acme-admins` exists.
josh_support: Hmm — empty group_attrs suggests SCIM/group mapping didn't populate at invite time. Did you recently change SCIM or claims?
acme-admin: Yes, we rotated OIDC client yesterday and our Okta team also migrated group attribute name from `groups` -> `memberOf` in SCIM push. We thought it was compatible.
idp_team_ravi: We did push that attribute rename. SCIM now exposes groups under `memberOf` for new events; older users still have `groups`. Looks like some events right around the cutover used the old field but our mapping service expects `memberOf`.
sre_kate: Hypothesis: group-sync/mapping job skipped role binding for invites that resolved during the attribute flip window. That would let API auth work (token scopes unaffected) but console UI role bindings missing -> 403 and hidden billing tab.
josh_support: Workaround: re-run the group-sync/backfill for org 112233. Internal endpoint: `POST /internal/admin/orgs/112233/sync-groups` (requires admin token). If you want we can kick it from our side.
acme-admin: Please run it — need access back for Sarah asap.
deploy-bot: Trigger received: POST /internal/admin/orgs/112233/sync-groups by josh_support (1799999997)
Status: queued -> running
deploy-bot: group-sync job 1799999997 running: scanning 1 orgs, 14 users, 6 groups
deploy-bot: group-sync job 1799999997 completed: bound 12 users to roles, 3 role bindings created, duration 3.2s
acme-admin: Sarah reloaded console and billing tab is back, she can see project settings now. Thanks!
josh_support: Good. Escalating for RCA and customer notification. Short summary: SCIM attribute rename (`groups` -> `memberOf`) caused transient mismatch during invite/window causing group_attrs to be empty at accept time. Mapping service skipped binding. We will backfill invites during the window and ship a fix to make mapper accept both attributes for a 24h grace.
idp_team_ravi: Filed IDP ticket IDP-4823, will schedule backfill for window 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z - 2026-03-15T03:30:00Z and notify impacted customers.
sre_kate: Eng will add compatibility layer to mapping service and add an alert if incoming SCIM payloads have unexpected attribute names.
acme-admin: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please send the incident/update email to ACME ops.
josh_support: Will do — sending summary + remediation steps now. :thumbsup:
